texts.zh:
我们进入了一个充满令人困惑的视觉奇景、几何图案和变幻莫测的色彩的空间。

尽管周围的环境看起来并不危险，但它们就像视错觉一样让人迷失方向。构成这个宇宙的物质令人困惑。无论这些样本如何放大，我们都会看到同样的重复模式，如同自身的无限浓缩。

很明显，在这个裂隙中有一些我们还不了解的物理原理。
texts.en:
We have entered a space of confusing visual spectacles, geometric patterns, and shifting colors.

The surroundings do not appear dangerous, but they are as disorientating as an optical illusion. Attempts to analyze the material that makes up this universe are baffling. No matter how intensely the samples are magnified, we are confronted by the same repeating patterns. It is as if they condense towards infinity.

Clearly, there are physical principles operating inside of this rift that we do not yet understand.

texts.zh:
这里的空间与我们的认知大相径庭。

我们舰船的移动不能带来预期的结果。向前推进时，舰船会向左平移；增大推力时反而将减慢速度。

[Leader.GetName]推测，这个宇宙具有超越三个以上的标准维度，这也带来了一些突破。也许以这个眼光检测周围环境，我们就可以开始理解这些图样。
texts.en:
Space works differently here.

The movements of our ship do not correspond to expected results. Propelling forward, we shift left; increasing our thrust, we slow down.

A breakthrough was made when [Leader.GetName] theorized that this universe allows access to more than the standard three spatial dimensions. Perhaps by examining our surroundings through this lens we can begin to find meaning in these patterns.

texts.zh:
如果不能充分理解这个宇宙，在其中我们寸步难行。因此，我们的所有子个体都被分派研究周围的环境。
起先这些数据似乎是毫无关联的随机噪音，直到[Leader.GetName]取得了突破：令人惊讶的是，这个宇宙具有超过三个的标准维度。也许以这个眼光检测周围环境，我们就可以开始理解这些图样。
texts.en:
It would be foolhardy to travel through this universe without understanding it more completely. Instead, every one of our drones has been dispatched in an effort to analyze our surroundings.
At first the data seemed to be an incoherent mess of random noise, until a breakthrough was made by [Leader.GetName]: incredibly, this universe provides access to more than the standard three spatial dimensions. Perhaps by examining things through this lens we can begin to find meaning in the patterns.

texts.zh:
对我们周围环境图样进行四维空间外推，我们成功的创建了一副可用的地图。这揭示了这些重复图样中存在着一个“中央舱室”。

从四维空间的角度来看，我们可以沿一条直线到达裂隙的中央，但我们自己却感觉通过了一条扭曲的轨迹、穿过一座难以理解的迷宫。要穿过这个迷宫，我们需要急转弯，有时还得往回走，但我们最终还是到达了目的地。

这个新空间非常巨大，大到逻辑上无法包含在舱室中，必然是更多折叠维度的结果。

在它的中心，我们找到了一个熟悉的装置。上面书写这的是我们自己的语言，是一套如何进一步进行的说明。
texts.en:
By extrapolating the patterns of our surroundings in four spatial dimensions, we've succeeded in creating a useable map. This has revealed the existence of a 'central chamber' within the repeated patterns.

While from the perspective of four dimensions our travel to the middle of the rift was a straight line, our own experience was a twisting trajectory through an incomprehensible labyrinth. Sharp turns and the occasional backtrack were required to traverse this maze, but we eventually reached our goal.

This new space is vast; it is far too large to logically be contained within the chamber itself, and must be the result of even more folded dimensions.

At its very center, we recovered a familiar device. Written in our own language, it was a set of instructions on how to proceed further.

texts.zh:
对我们周围环境图样进行四维空间外推，我们成功的创建了一副可用的地图。这揭示了这些重复图样中存在着一个“中央舱室”。

从四维空间的角度来看，我们可以沿一条直线到达裂隙的中央，但我们自己却感觉通过了一条扭曲的轨迹、穿过一座难以理解的迷宫。要穿过这个迷宫，我们需要急转弯，有时还得往回走，但我们最终还是到达了目的地。

这个新空间非常巨大，大到逻辑上无法包含在舱室中，必然是更多折叠维度的结果。

在它的中心，我们找到了一个熟悉的装置。上面书写这的是我们自己的语言，是一套如何进一步进行的说明。

而他上面的签名正式[Leader.GetName]。这是一封来自未来自己的信息。
texts.en:
By extrapolating the patterns of our surroundings in four spatial dimensions, we've succeeded in creating a useable map. This has revealed the existence of a 'central chamber' within the repeated patterns.

While from the perspective of four dimensions our travel to the middle of the rift was a straight line, our own experience was a twisting trajectory through an incomprehensible labyrinth. Sharp turns and the occasional backtrack were required to traverse this maze, but we eventually reached our goal.

This new space is vast; it is far too large to logically be contained within the chamber itself, and must be the result of even more folded dimensions.

At its very center, we recovered a familiar device. Written in our own language, it was a set of instructions on how to proceed further.

It was signed by none other than [Leader.GetName]. This is a message from us... in the future.

texts.zh:
我们在所有的时间轴上进行旅行。

按照摆在我们面前的指示，我们轻松地穿越了未知数量的超空间维度。好几回，我们看到自己从另一条路线穿过。我们的其他一些副本似乎处于困境中，他们裂隙探球的腐蚀破旧也说明他们在这个空间迷失了许久。

幸运的是，到目前为止我们还没有直接遭遇。我们已经为自己留下了指示，以防止这种危险的时间同步发生。
texts.en:
We are traveling through time across all axes.

Following the instructions laid before us, we navigated easily through an unknown amount of super-spatial dimensions. At various points, we witnessed ourselves crossing from another course. Some of our other copies appeared to be in distress, with the wear and corrosion on their Rift Sphere indicating they have been lost in this space for much too long.

Luckily, we have avoided direct encounters thus far. We have left our own instructions behind us to prevent such a dangerous temporal simultaneity from occurring.

texts.zh:
终于，我们达到了或许就是这个迷宫真正终点的中心。

我们处在一个由许多未知维度编织成的空间，我们的传感器对其的显示是如同万花筒一般的跃动色彩。在其最核心处漂浮着三个透明球仪，每一个都包含着向一个轴向无限重复的图样。我推测，这个宇宙所包含的每一个维度都有一个球仪与之对应，但我们只能与我们可观测的三个发生交互。

这里就再也没有什么指引了。缺失来自未来自我的信息可能表明，与这些球仪互动可能会产生可怕的后果。
texts.en:
At last we have reached the center of what must be the true end of this maze.

We are in a space composed of so many unknown dimensions that our senses can only perceive it as a wild kaleidoscope of colors and motion. At its very core, three transparent globes are floating, each containing an infinitely repeating pattern in one axial direction. We suspect that there must be a globe for each dimension contained in this universe, but we can only interact with our perceivable three.

There are no further instructions to be found. This lack of messages from our future selves could indicate that interacting with these globes may have dire consequences.

texts.zh:
我们从裂隙回来时，有另两个球体也跟随着我们。也许是由其他维度的我们驾驶的，我们“仨”在到达阈限时融合（或者说坍缩？）成了一体。

怪异的是，我们取回的这三个球仪并没有像这样也合并在一起。同一个物体的九个时间版本出现在了同一个空间。

当放置于独立的容器中，它们自发地自我弯曲进入额外维度，增加了周围空间的有效容积。我们还不确定这个效应的扩展极限，但推测这个装置可以在人口稠密的区域派上大用场。
texts.en:
As we returned back through the rift, two other Spheres came with us. Presumably crewed by other versions of ourselves, we 'three' fused (or were reduced?) into one at its threshold.

Strangely, the three orbs we recovered did not converge in the same manner. Nine temporal versions of the same objects now exist in one space.

When placed in individual containers, they naturally bend themselves into an extra dimension and increase the effective size of their surrounding space. We are not sure yet of the limits of this expansion, but theorize these devices could be of great use in densely populated areas.

texts.zh:
尽管我们选择不将球仪带走，最终我们还是发现它们三个出现在裂隙的这端。一定是另一个我们取回了它们。

通过实验，我们发现了这些球仪具有有趣又实用的性质。具体来说，它们可以弯曲进入额外维度，增加周围空间的有效容积。我们还不确定这个效应的扩展极限，但推测这个装置可以在人口稠密的区域派上大用场。
texts.en:
Though we chose not to take any of the globes with us, we have nonetheless ended up with all three of them on the near side of the rift. One of our other selves must have recovered them.

On experimentation, they exhibit interesting and useful properties. Specifically, they bend into an extra dimension, increasing the effective size of their surrounding space. We are not sure yet of the limits of this expansion, but theorize these devices could be of great use in densely populated areas.
